description: This file defines the JsonPointer interface, which models a hierarchical path within a JSON object, including methods for parsing, manipulating, and retrieving parts of JSON pointers.

classes.name: JsonPointer
classes.description: An interface representing an immutable hierarchical path within a JSON object, with methods for parsing, extending, trimming, and retrieving parts of the path.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty JSON pointer represented by "/".

methods.name: of
methods.description: Parses a slash-delimited string to create a new JsonPointer, supporting escape sequences for special characters.

methods.name: addLeaf
methods.description: Creates a new JsonPointer by adding a JSON key as a new leaf level.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends another JsonPointer to this pointer, forming a combined path.

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of levels in the JSON pointer.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the JSON pointer is empty (has no levels).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON key at a specified level, if present.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root JSON key of the pointer.

methods.name: getLeaf
methods.description: Returns the leaf JSON key of the pointer.

methods.name: cutLeaf
methods.description: Removes the leaf element from the pointer, returning a new pointer.

methods.name: nextLevel
methods.description: Returns a new pointer starting from the next sub-level.

methods.name: getSubPointer
methods.description: Returns a sub-path starting from a specified level upwards.

methods.name: getPrefixPointer
methods.description: Returns a sub-path from the root to a specified level.

methods.name: toFieldSelector
methods.description: Converts this pointer into a JsonFieldSelector containing this pointer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the JSON pointer.
